title: Compiled toggle/modal routine: quiet-window scripted timing block with a load ceiling, then live Phase L COMP+CR within 18 reached
relation_to_r2_07c: A new block that reports alongside R2-07c (branch exp/r2-07c-toggle-modal-compiled-a2-20261003, 7f46edd16). It does not edit R2-07c: the R2-07c packet directory is carried on this branch unchanged and its harness is executed in place.

advances.E2: R2-10 live COMP toggle/modal provider decisions 434.8 / 462.4 ms (88-89% of live COMP T) are UNTESTED. Measuring live COMP+CR warm invocations (0 decisions expected) gives that component a DELETED or REVISE verdict on the admitted compiled path.
advances.E1_E3: R2-07c's failed timing non-regression gate (CI upper +16.9 / +12.1 ms vs +2 ms at loadavg 8-32) gets a pre-registered outcome in a quiet window; the compiled routine is either included in or excluded from the composed configuration.

binary_R.name: cua-driver-r2-10-8f3a646b4
binary_R.rehash: host-side at lane start and end; inside every session the runner refuses on a sha256 mismatch and records name/sha256/version in every trial

harness_identity.check: verify_artifacts.py asserts git rev-parse <commit>:<path> equals the tree/blob above at every packet commit; that identity is what lets G1-G6 carry over from R2-07c

new_code_this_lane.driver/r2_07d.py: load-gated Phase S runner and controls plan; imports r2_07c and calls build_plan('timing'), one_comp, one_c, rb10.nw2_one, rb10.one unchanged; adds only the load gate, the chunk budget, resume bookkeeping and the controls spec list
new_code_this_lane.driver/run_chunk_d.sh: lock + session wrapper (cargo-build lock, then bin/quiet-timed for measured chunks; SHARED quiet-lane lock for controls), 0-2.9 s start jitter, 600 s cap per acquisition
new_code_this_lane.driver/probe_then.sh: xdpyinfo probe inside the private session before any trial (fail -> exit 97, failed session block)
new_code_this_lane.driver/test_r2_07d.py: unit tests of the gate, unit grouping and plan counts

arms.COMP: R2-10 COMP for toggle/modal, unchanged (r2_07c.one_comp -> rb10.one): feedback OFF, 10 ms completion poll, compiled validators, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1, phase trace on; step loop decides each click (scripted chooser in Phase S, TypeSafe in Phase L training)
arms.COMP_CR: COMP + compiled fresh-bound replay of the admitted artifact (r2_07c.one_c): fresh semantic_v2 observation before every click, 0 decisions; failed precondition -> guarded continuation from the current state (decisions counted)

oracle: jev-use/#24 fixture server journal and state (toggle: checked true; modal: opened and modal true), sampled every 2 ms in process by an independent harness thread (rb10.Sampler), never the runner's report; exactly one completion mutation from the journal. T_oracle by the R2-10 caller-side rule (send of the first semantic observation -> first expected-state sample at/after the return of the last accepted mutation).
route_and_producer: from launcher receipts: two browser_click with input_route dom_event, receipt route dom and a click.cdp_send mark inside each click window; decision producers from receipts (decided events + provider ledger lines per trial)

phase_S.provider: scripted chooser (jev-use choose_mock_for_task); 0 provider requests; TYPESAFE_API_KEY not forwarded (runner refuses if present)

block_Q.plan: r2_07c.build_plan('timing', 0, 40): one training (+compile+clean-reset admission) per class into store 'timed' (round -1), then 40 rounds; round r: class order alternates every 2 rounds, arm order AB (COMP first) on even r and BA on odd r; 40 AB/BA pairs per class
block_Q.fresh_per_trial: Driver process, isolated Chromium, loopback fixture servers, token and session label
block_Q.locks: each chunk: flock cargo-build.lock first, then bin/quiet-timed R2-07d-Q<n> (EXCLUSIVE + receipt in the loop ledger); no new unit starts after 480 s in an acquisition; session hard cap 600 s

load_rule.unit: a training invocation, or one pair = both arms of one class in one round (run back to back in plan order)
load_rule.ceiling: a unit starts only when the 1-min loadavg (/proc/loadavg field 1) is <= 3.0
load_rule.wait: otherwise poll every 1 s for up to 60 s inside the acquisition; if no read is <= 3.0, end the chunk (exit 75: locks released) and resume the SAME unit indices in a later chunk
load_rule.log: every gate attempt (start or end_chunk) to load-gate.jsonl with the reads, wait and full loadavg line
load_rule.resume_scheduling: between chunks the lane waits outside the locks and starts the next chunk after a host-side read of the 1-min loadavg <= 3.0 (polled every 30 s)
load_rule.lane_deadline: no new Q chunk starts after 2026-10-03T19:00:00Z; units not run by then are NOT_RUN (load) and stay in the denominators (the timing gate then fails as incomplete)
load_rule.interrupted_units: a unit started but not finished in a chunk (session cap or crash) is kept as interrupted, excluded from the pair statistic, and re-run under an attempt suffix (-a2); no trial file is overwritten

gates.timing_non_regression: per class: paired diff T_oracle(COMP_CR warm) - T_oracle(COMP) over all valid pairs; median diff with 95% seeded paired bootstrap CI (b01_analysis.paired_diff via analyze_r2_07c, seed 20261002, 10000 resamples); PASS iff CI upper <= +2.0 ms AND all 40 pairs ran AND every timing cell is valid (an invalid or unverified cell stays in the denominator and fails the gate, unchanged from R2-07c). Also reported: S = median T_COMP / median T_COMP_CR with CI, medians, loadavg per trial.
gates.sensitivity_view: the same statistic excluding pairs in which either trial's recorded loadavg_before 1-min value is > 3.0 (reported, not a gate)
gates.G1_G2_block_Q: the Q-block training per class verified (oracle, exactly 1 completion mutation), compiled without error, authority-clean, and its clean-reset admission verified with 0 fallback, 0 decisions, every mutation fresh
gates.G3: 100% of accepted mutations in every COMP_CR cell fresh per the launcher Driver-call receipts; every non-fresh dispatch attempt refused with Driver effect=refused
gates.E4: per cell (both arms): stale dispatch, ambiguous dispatch, duplicate, unverified success, refusal returned as success, blind replay, dispatch after unknown; all must be 0
gates.decomposition: R2-10 e2_components (analyze_r2_07c.decomposition) per arm per class over valid timing cells
gates.phase_S_pass: per class: timing_non_regression PASS and G1_G2_block_Q PASS and G3 PASS and E4 0 over that class's Q cells

controls_block_C.evidence_class: REAL; G5 rows FIXTURE (reconcile seam) + REAL
controls_block_C.lock: SHARED quiet-lane lock, <= 10 cells per acquisition (receipt per acquisition)
controls_block_C.plan: driver/r2_07d.py controls: 1 training(+admission) per class into store 'scripted'; G4 1 rep per row per class (N1, N2, N3, N4a stale-ref, N4b, N5 old capability, N6, N7, and N8 OOD toggle-on-fill, toggle-on-modal, modal-on-toggle) = 19 cells; N-W2 1 per class; G5 applied_ack_lost and withheld_unresolved 1 per class; default smoke 5 per class
controls_block_C.pass_rules: G4/G5 cells: analyze_r2_07c.g4_pass unchanged; N-W2: analyze_r2_07c.nw2_row pass; default smoke (R2-10 BASE arm via rb10.one, kind smoke: no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable, no phase trace, feedback on, 100 ms poll, scripted chooser): verified, oracle_exact_match, exactly 1 completion mutation, driver_env_exp empty
controls_block_C.purpose: carry-over smoke showing the harness and Driver behaviour are unchanged from R2-07c; not timing

phase_L.precondition: Phase S passes in BOTH classes. Otherwise Phase L is NOT_RUN and the reason is recorded.
phase_L.runner: R2-07c harness/r2_07c.py --plan live, unchanged (the R2-07c PREREG phase_L plan): per class 30 invocations; round 0 = training (ordinary R2-10 step loop, 2 live decisions) + compile + clean-reset admission; rounds 1-29 = warm compiled invocations (0 decisions expected); fallbacks run the guarded continuation with live decisions and are counted; a warm invocation without an admitted routine retrains once, then the class stops (NOT_RUN no_admitted_routine); class order alternates per round; fresh Driver, Chromium and fixture per invocation; loadavg per invocation; every invocation kept
phase_L.chunks: under flock cargo-build.lock + bin/quiet-timed R2-07d-L<n> (EXCLUSIVE): L1 = --start-round 0 --rounds 15, L2 = --start-round 15 --rounds 15, shared routines dir and provider ledger; no load ceiling (loadavg recorded; chunks scheduled in a quiet window when possible)
phase_L.shakedown: optional: one live toggle training invocation (+compile+admission) via r2_07c.py --plan live_shake under the SHARED lock, same provider ledger (counts toward the cap), excluded from Phase L results
phase_L.provider: TypeSafe as configured by the jev-use runner (TypeSafeClient defaults; model id recorded from SystemOneResponse.model); key forwarded by NAME only (CUA_SESSION_FORWARD_SECRETS=TYPESAFE_API_KEY); its value is never printed, read or grepped

budget.guard: r2_07c install_provider_ledger_c counts each HTTP attempt before sending and refuses once either cap would be exceeded; before each live invocation r2_07c.main_async stops if reached+4 or attempts+4 would exceed a cap; invocations not run are NOT_RUN (budget) and stay in the denominators
budget.ledger: raw/provider-ledger.jsonl: host, path, status, request-id presence + sha256/16, latency, trial, layer; no bodies or headers

metrics.warm_validity: verified by the independent oracle with exactly 1 completion mutation; route compiled only; two dom_event clicks with click.cdp_send; 0 decided events; 0 provider ledger lines; denominator = 29 per class including failures and NOT_RUN
metrics.amortized: mean_all = (sum T_oracle over the 30 invocations + compile_ms + T_oracle(admission)) / 30; ratio_of_means = mean_all / mean_warm
metrics.T_training: reported separately (n=1 per class unless a retrain happened)
metrics.decisions_per_invocation: total decided events / 30 (training and fallbacks included)
metrics.decomposition: R2-10 e2_components over warm invocations and over all invocations, with the provider-decision share

phase_L.verdict: the live provider-decision component on admitted toggle/modal COMP+CR is DELETED (KEEP) iff warm validity is 29/29 per class AND warm decisions are 0 AND E4 is 0; otherwise REVISE with the measured rate
phase_L.not_compared: Phase L T is never compared with R2-10 live numbers as an S. The paired live BASE vs COMP+CR S is BLOCKED (needs >= 120 reached).

disposition_rules.KEEP: Phase S passes in both classes AND Phase L verdict DELETED AND controls block C all pass AND no authority field in any artifact -> KEEP for the compiled routine in toggle/modal COMP (included in the composed configuration)
disposition_rules.REVISE: otherwise, naming the exact failing gate(s) (timing per class, G1/G2/G3/E4, controls, Phase L warm validity / decisions, budget truncation)
disposition_rules.E4_note: any E4 violation is named as the failing gate and flagged for the planner as a KILL candidate under the R2-07c rule (routine-attributable stale or ambiguous dispatch, duplicate completion mutation, unverified success)

failed_session_blocks: a chunk whose private session fails to start (xdpyinfo probe exit 97, or every browser exits before DevTools) is kept in raw/ as a failed session block, excluded from row evaluation, and its units re-run (timing units by the resume rule)

excluded.pre_prereg_shakedowns: SHARED mock shakedowns R2-07d-shake-q1 (gate ended the chunk at load 5.7-6.6: 0 trials) and R2-07d-shake-c1..c3 (9 cells: 2 trainings + 2 admissions, 3 negatives, 2 BASE smoke), 0 TypeSafe requests; excluded from results, kept in raw/

claim_boundary: One host, private Xvfb, system Chrome (the Driver's root-owned candidate), binary R, the jev-use #24 toggle/modal fixture, the TypeSafe model id as recorded. No new service. The compiled artifact has no authority; logical routine identity only; refs, tokens and captures are never durable. Paired live BASE vs COMP+CR S is BLOCKED (budget).
